matchups.tips: Samira can and WILL destroy you in lane. Your support doesn't matter. Samira's wind wall can block all of your E and your R. She out heals you and out damages you all game. It's best not to pick Tristana into Samira.

You lose. Sorry. Oh, you want me to go in-depth? He out damages you in the early game, can cancel your W, can execute you, always wins the early game unless you're Miss Fortune. If the enemy has a Draven do NOT play Tristana.
What's that? You wanted to play the game? Too bad! Enjoy getting CC'd to death!
She will normally take her dodge level 2 just because of you. Permaban if you can. You will NOT win lane against Nilah.
This guy is going to be a major pain in the ass in lane. Do NOT stand away from your support. This guy's going to take advantage of you any way he can.
An ADC's worst nightmare. Do NOT come out from behind minions. Do NOT position yourself away from your support. Do NOT play like an idiot. You WILL die.

Galio support isn't uncommon, but it's VERY deadly. Watch out for that dash and don't eat free Qs. Also watch out for defensive stance, he can easily eat everything you throw at him and still come out on top.
Her engage hurts, her stun is long, her ult hurts AND stuns too long, if you see a Leona, it's gonna suck for you. I hope your footwork is good.
This guy is hard. Pun intended. His poke is unavoidable, when he all ins it's extremely damaging, and his ult is game-changing. Don't expect to have a fun time against a Malphite.

VERY BAD MATCHUP. Let your support tank the passive hit and stay behind your minions. When he engages, engage on the enemy ADC. Do NOT engage on the support. Deal with him later. Naut has some incredible CC, but low damage.
You're not going to have fun. Ward as much as you possibly can.
Play as safe as you possibly can with this guy. He undoes your damage, your engage, and can follow up with his own. You don't win against Fizz.
This guy denies your laning phase. Play under tower if you can. He can make you completely useless without even trying. Do not EVER engage on him alone.

He's an anti-carry for a reason. His silence can ruin your engages, his little minions can push you back to tower faster than you can, and his burn can poke you to hell and back. His Ult completely ruins you.
Get early grievous wounds if you can and for the love of god do NOT get grabbed. He can and will destroy you in lane.
There's no playing if this guy is around. He bullies you easily. He takes very little damage for some reason. His shields are broken. Don't expect to be useful if you lane against Yone.
You die. That's it. He deals stupid strong poke damage, his engages are impossible to fight back because of how much he moves around, and he's a burst assassin.

Cait isn't too bad so long as you're able to dodge poke. Be wary of those traps. They're called YORDLE snap traps for a reason. If the Cait is competent enough, she'll usually trap you in the area you're jumping in. Her net can also slow you severely, and next thing you know, all your health is gone. Be careful here.

Miss Fortune out damages you in the early game and that poke is stupidly hard-hitting. You can stay behind minions all you want, but Miss Fortune is going to get you anyway. if you can get past the poke, you do out damage her in most trades. Though she scales insanely hard. Be careful when taking trades late.
Kalista ain't too good right now, but her mobility makes it so your all-ins don't work that well. CC her, and she dies. Easy.

Same case with Samira, except its not 360 degrees around him. This matchup is less hard and more irritating. Bait out the wind wall and be careful of the knock-up. You do all that, and you'll be okay.
You can't jump out of his E. His W is insane. His Q is fast. His R destroys you. I hate APCs with a burning passion.

Quinn ADC isn't very common, but it can happen. When it does, she can very well wreck you in lane if you're not careful. Her engage also doubles as a disengage, she can keep getting her passive off on you and just kite you away. It completely ruins your engages. Her blind can also ruin your engages. Though you do outscale her really hard because Quinn is balanced to be a top laner and not an ADC.
Don't stand too close to walls or units when you think he has his stun up. His auto attacks do stupid amounts of damage and his ult is SO annoying. His sustain is terrible.

This guy is just a pain in the ass in general. His poke is stupid strong his stun moves fast, his ult will demolish you, and his late game his terrifying. Though, if you watch for his all in, he's really a free kill afterward.
Don't go in bushes, save your W for when he engages. He's tanky, but not very mobile. Kite him as best you can.
If you can tell when he's going to engage, back off. He's not impossible to deal with. He's extremely mobile and hard to catch, so don't kill him if you don't kill the enemy ADC first.
If you let her catch you, you're dead. If you don't, you're fine. Rell is very engage-heavy, so she's going to want to take advantage of you whenever she can. DO NOT LET HER.

DO NOT EAT Qs. It's easy enough to watch where he's going to throw his hook and it's countered by being behind minions. However, don't W away UNTIL he uses his flay. A lot of newbie Tristanas make this mistake.
His ult counters you by just existing. DO NOT KILL AS FAST AS YOU CAN. WAIT FOR THE CHRONOSHIFT.

She's your soft counter in mid. She's known for absolutely demolishing ADCs with her stupid high burst. Watch her stacks. Don't engage when she has her stun. If you can avoid her CC you should be good.
Don't let her Q you to death. Keep your distance until you're ready to engage. Don't stay too close. The closer you get to Diana the more she can kill you.
Don't get hit by the barrels. When he uses them, engage on him. Watch for his poke. He has strong damage but little in terms of escape.
Play VERY safe. Her CC hurts a lot and her burst isn't anything to scoff at. Play under tower and wait for your jungler.
Get poked. Get killed. Rinse and repeat. Play safe under tower. Most rumbles have a tendency to perma push their lane.
She counters anyone with mobility. Specifically YOU. Play under tower. Don't jump around too much and don't take too much poke.
Avoid his poke as much as you possibly can. He does a lot of damage early and only does more as the game goes on. You don't win 1v1s reliably. Wait for ganks.

Primarily skill-based. Vayne can do some stupid damage, but you can prevent that so long as you deny her the early game. If she doesn't get fed, you can out damage her. Just keep track of her so she doesn't get fed off of others.

Pretty even match up, really depends on the support. Jhin's CC can be irritating, and be careful of that fourth shot. Other than that, you should be okay to go in so long as his abilities are down. He can't escape if you jump in on him. Communicate with your support and go in on Jhin after he wastes his fourth shot.

This little bugger is really irritating. He pokes like a coward and you can't really do anything about it. Just hope your support is anyone with a grab, really. He's immobile, so if you can get the drop on him, you're good. Have your support tank the damage, also. You do have the upper hand in most 1v1s because of how you are, but make sure to save your W for when he's about to explode after he dies.

DO NOT LET HIM GET FIRST BLOOD ON YOU. Lucian snowballs like crazy. He has a dash, so he can escape you pretty easily, and his passive can be hard to fight against. You have to play the lane pretty passive if you wanna fight this guy and win. But if this guy doesn't take the early game, it's free EXP and gold for you.
I'd put this guy in Minor if it wasn't for his camoflauge. Respect that, buy control wards, and be careful when he hits six. Do not leave your support's side.
This match-up is just confusing. Better Tristana wins. Bait out W, watch for the bomb, yadda yadda, you get it.
Skill-based. Dodge the root, mind the poke and wait for your support to CC them. Then you win.

He's not as good as he used to be, but you should still be careful. Akshan can poke better than you and outdamages you in short trades because of his passive and has an easy escape if he know how his grappling hook works, but later on when you have a few items he isn't too bad.
Seraphine APC is irritating. Unless you're Tristana. This match-up is entirely support-based. If Seraphine has no sustain support, you'll win in most situations. Just bait out the echo.

For some reason, this clown is in Bot Lane. honestly, he's not too bad. He's incredibly immobile, and his weird wall doesn't affect your jump, only when you get out. And when you kill him, you can jump out of his range. Just don't play like an idiot.
Braum isn't too bad. Be careful of his Q and his ult. His shield can be pretty difficult to play around, but he's not unbreakable.
Annoying in lane, easy to exploit, though. You can jump on her and force her to use ult, her tornadoes are hard to dodge, but not impossible.
Hardly a problem until later. Her poke can hurt and her root can be annoying, but if your support can tank that, it's a free kill.
DO. NOT. EAT. HER. Q. Dodge it, and when you do, go in. She literally cannot do anything if you engage on her if she doesn't have her Q. Her E can hurt, but it hurts less when you're not immobile.

Her poke is annoying with her E, and her Q can be painful if she hits you, though it's the same case with Lux. Don't get hit by her Q. Engage when she has it down. You'll either force her ult or get a free kill.
Watch out for his engage. His engage is easy to see and it's easy to get away from him. Have him target your support instead of you.
Watch for the charm and don't take too much poke. You can wreck her pre-level six and deny her snowball, just don't let her poke you down early game.
You can kill her easily pre level six. Don't bother trying to jump on her because of how hard she is to catch. So, always keep your rocket jump at the ready.
He's an annoying matchup, but not impossible. He's mobile, but you're more mobile. Punish as many mistakes as you can and don't get too close if you don't plan on engaging.
Don't take needless poke. He's really good at that. Abuse him pre-six if you can.
Watch for the package and his poke. He's got no real reliable escape pre-six, so you can bully him easily. Though he can easily demolish you later in the game if you let him.
He's really not much of a threat if you can predict where his stun zone is. He can disengage decently, and his ult can undo your engage, so abuse him pre-six if you can.
Abuse her pre six and before she gets her vamp scepter. When she ults you can easily rocket jump out of it and get to safety. Don't get hit by the stun or you WILL die.
Just bully him pre-six. You don't have any channels that he can reliably cancel. His E can hurt, but if you run Magic Resist runes or Bone Plating, you can take it.
Pre six, it's just a matter of abusing her cooldowns. Don't take needless poke and you should be good. After level six, play safe. Her ult can deny your engage entirely.

Watch for her root. Avoid it if you can. Don't take needless poke and avoid her after level six if she's disguised. Jump out of her ult when she tries to use it. She has no good escape since your E follows the real neeko when she uses her W.
Poke as much as you can and don't take CC. Don't stand near walls. Don't follow her if she roams.
Really, it's just a farming lane. Don't take poke. Poke him if he gets too close.
Not too much of a problem if you can avoid her orbs. She has no good escape, though she has really strong burst. Don't underestimate her damage.
Watch that rake and try to fight off his engages. He's pretty easy to bully if you know what you're doing. I'd recommend saving your jump for when he ults so he has a harder time getting to you.
Really, all you need to do is avoid the bubble and engage on her when she doesn't have it. This is a pretty easy lane if you can dodge skillshots.

I love this matchup. I see an Ashe, and I ALWAYS pick Tristana. Sure, she can poke you, but what can she do when you jump on her? Nothing. Just make sure your support is around, and you're golden. You out damage her, and she has no form of escape except kiting, and you normally have the advantage there since you out range here.
Ezreal? Who's that? Never heard of him. Ezreal can poke you, but you out damage him in the early game. Deny him the early game and he can't snowball.

Jinx is pretty annoying with how she can push so easily with her Q, but you're Tristana. You're one of the most snowball-y ADCs in the game. Just hope your support can grab, and you can win. Be mindful of her E. You have no Y-axis, so it can root you even if you're jumping. Her W isn't too bad, though. It's easy to dodge if you know how to move. Deny her the early game and you're set for an easy game.

More irritating than too much of a threat. Don't get too close to her. Wait for your support to make the first move, and you'll usually win the fight. Don't take 1v1s with her if she takes the early game. You WILL lose faster than you can say "Bot Diff". But if you deny her the early game, you're set.

Ever since her minor rework, she hasn't been too bad of a matchup. Her Q is annoying at first, but as long as you can walk to the side, it's not too bad. Bait out the spell shield, go in, and you're good. Don't eat Qs.
Watch out for the feathers. That's it. If she doesn't have her E up, you win.

Back when I made this guide, this was when Aphelios was a level 2 hypercarry who only needed his stupid flamethower and his stupid gravity gun to get a free lane. But now? He's just a joke. Don't engage when he has his gravity gun. Don't take free poke. Watch for his red gun/chakrams when you engage because it heals him and constantly damages you.

I hate APCs with a passion. But Ziggs is a massive letdown. Ziggs can poke you, but what can he do when you jump on him? He can use his satchel charge, sure, but then what? Just walk in a different direction that where his Q is coming from and don't walk into the minefield. Build a Wit's End if you're not to confident.
He literally cannot do anything without his R. His blight stacks hurt, yeah, but if you're smart enough he won't be able to use it.

Not very common, but it can happen. And when it does, it's a free win for you. Kindred's ult is useless since you can ult them out of it. You out damage her in all parts of the game if you deny her stacks.

AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Oh, I should talk about this, shouldn't I? Her escape is annoying. That's it. She can't kite away from you because you have better mobility, her damage is meh, and her poke is laughable.
Bait out polymorph and it's a free kill. She's hardly an issue alone, which she usually never is, but in the case she is, enjoy the free kills.

Nami isn't much of an issue in lane so long as you know how to dodge her bubbles. Her poke can hurt, but it's the same case with Lux and Morgana. Bait out the bubble, engage. Simple as that. Buy some lifesteal if the poke is proving to be too annoying.
Literally only watch out for W and Ult. That's it. Beyond that, she's hardly even an issue.
It's really a free kill. Her poke is annoying, but beyond that and her ult, she can't do much against you.
More a threat to your team than a threat to you. You have all the power in the world to demolish her, but a competent Soraka will always be with her team. Stay vigilant and kill her whenever you can.

Taric is tanky, but you really should only worry about his ult. Even then, it shouldn't be an issue if you can kill the enemy ADC fast enough. His stun is easy enough to dodge and his heal is nothing to write home about. His auto attacks are beastly, however. Be cautious.
TAKE CLEANSE. Other than that, Teemo's just annoying. You kill him faster than he kills you. Cleanse his blind, get the kill, get out. Buy a wit's end, too.
He's an immobile damage support. Stay behind minions. Engage when his knockup is down and he's easy enough to kill during his ult since he can't move while he's using it.
She's just annoying. That's it. Don't eat Qs. Buy Grievous Wounds
Stay away from sprouted plants and walk over the plant bulbs. Don't eat her root and W out of her ult when you see her use it. Other than that, she's a free kill.
An absolute joke in mid. You absolutely wreck her. Her wall does nothing to stop you if you have your jump. Her stun can hurt, but it's slow. You burst her down faster than she can.
Buy early grievous wounds and don't take needless poke. Watch for her ult and you can bully her easily in lane.
Just bully her. She isn't a burst assassin early on. You can easily just use your range advantage to bully her. If she engages on you, you got better burst and your ult can knock her out of hers.
Just don't take poke and abuse her in lane. That's just it. Her damage is sup-par. Her ult can hurt a little, but you do more damage than her.
His stun doesn't last very long, his red card is easy to avoid, and his blue card shouldn't be an issue. His poke is easy to dodge. Just bully hm and you should be good.
